description: Full detail for one PowerPoint template deck: description, every slide it contains (title, page URL, preview image), tags, preview images in all three color schemes (Azure, Emerald, Crimson), related templates, and how to get it (single purchase for $20 or subscription). Takes the template_id (slug) from search_templates or list_templates.

template_id.description: Template slug, e.g. "business-case", or numeric deck ID.
